queries.name: historical-amounts
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS original_orders,SUM(COALESCE(f.refund_business_income_amount,0)<>r.income) AS income_mismatch,SUM(COALESCE(f.refund_deposit_amount,0)<>r.deposit) AS deposit_mismatch,SUM(COALESCE(f.refund_business_income_amount,0)<>r.income OR COALESCE(f.refund_deposit_amount,0)<>r.deposit) AS either_mismatch,SUM(COALESCE(f.refund_business_income_amount,0)-r.income) AS income_overstated,SUM(COALESCE(f.refund_deposit_amount,0)-r.deposit) AS deposit_overstated FROM (SELECT o.source_order_no,SUM(CASE WHEN d.subject_no='202' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposit,SUM(CASE WHEN d.subject_no IN ('101','300') THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS income FROM ol_saps.customer_order o JOIN ol_saps.customer_order_detail d ON d.order_no=CONVERT(o.order_no USING utf8) COLLATE utf8_general_ci AND d.is_delete=0 WHERE o.id BETWEEN 1 AND 649094 AND o.project_no='PRJ000060' AND o.sub_type=3001 AND o.status=4 AND o.is_delete=0 AND o.is_cancel=0 GROUP BY o.source_order_no) r JOIN ol_saps.replace_battery_device_flow f ON f.order_no=CONVERT(r.source_order_no USING utf8) COLLATE utf8_general_ci AND f.is_delete=0 AND f.is_cancel=0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ol_saps.customer_order newer WHERE newer.source_order_no=r.source_order_no AND newer.id>649094 AND newer.status=4 AND newer.is_delete=0 AND newer.is_cancel=0) LIMIT 1
